designSystem.name: Pinchy Agents Visual System
designSystem.description: Modern, clean visual design system for agent management interface using shadcn/ui primitives
principles: Clarity over decoration - simpler layouts with fewer visual treatments
Component-first - build as shadcn compositions, not styled HTML
Consistency - reuse patterns from existing Pinchy UI
